info.title: OpenAsy Posture API
info.summary: Which controls of a cloud account, cluster or host fail, kept per target with a score over time.
info.description:
Every screen of posture uses this API, and so can your scripts and CI (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

Send SARIF 2.1.0 reports from Trivy, kubescape, checkov, Prowler or another checker with `POSTURE_INGEST_TOKEN`. Everything else takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

post.description:
Takes a SARIF 2.1.0 report from Trivy, kubescape, checkov, Prowler or another checker of configuration, for a target that exists. Results need a resource: `properties.resource`, a logical location or the artifact. Optional `properties.benchmark`, `control`, `section` and `security-severity` (on the result or its rule) are kept. Results of kind `pass` count as passed controls and are not findings. A run's `properties.summary` `{passed, failed, total}` gives the pass rate when the report does not list its passed controls.

What the same engine reported before and does not report now is fixed. The first report of an engine adopts what is there; later ones fail the check for new failed controls at or above the target's `failOn`.

```bash
trivy config --format sarif -o results.sarif .
curl -sf -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $POSTURE_INGEST_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @results.sarif \
  "https://posture.example.com/api/v1/scans?target=prod-cluster" | tee scan.json
test "$(jq .passed scan.json)" = true
```

The body may be gzipped (`Content-Encoding: gzip`), up to 64 MiB unpacked, with at most 50,000 results.

Takes POSTURE_INGEST_TOKEN, or an API token with the editor role.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: Which engine made the report. Without it, the first word of the tool's name in lowercase, such as `trivy` or `kubescape`. Reports of one engine replace each other; engines do not fix each other's findings.

201.description: Compared with what the engine reported before. `passed` says whether the check passes.

post.description:
A cloud account, a Kubernetes cluster or a group of hosts whose configuration is judged.

Needs the admin role.

patch.description:
Sets the benchmark label and the severity that fails a check.

Needs the admin role.

delete.description:
Deletes its reports, findings and decisions.

Needs the admin role.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `open` (default): reported by its engine and not triaged. `suppressed`: triaged and still reported. `resolved`: no longer reported.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches the rule, control, resource or message.

put.description:
Marks a finding as a false positive or accepted risk, with a reason, or opens it again. The decision stays with the finding across reports.

Needs the editor role.

parameters.name: fingerprint
parameters.description: From a finding or a report.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `open` (default): reported by its engine and not triaged. `suppressed`: triaged and still reported. `resolved`: no longer reported.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches the rule, control, resource or message.

200.description: From OPENASY_PRODUCTS, for the product switcher.
Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

get.description:
One point per report that had a check count, oldest first, up to 120.

Needs the viewer role.

What open findings carry, for filters.

Needs the viewer role.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when posture runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the posture origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_posture_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when posture is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

ingestToken.description: `POSTURE_INGEST_TOKEN`: for CI. It can send scans, nothing else.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

FailOn.description: The lowest severity of a new finding that fails the check; `none` never fails it.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

active.description: False once the acceptance has expired; the finding is open again.

state.description: `compensating`: another control covers the risk, with the reason. `open` clears an earlier decision.

expiresAt.description: Required for accepted, at most 366 days away; optional for the others.

failingChecks.description: Reports of the last 7 days that failed their check.

averageScore.description: Mean of the newest score of every target that has one, 0 to 100.

hostsFile.description: null when OPENASY_HOSTS is not set.

benchmark.description: A label such as CIS Kubernetes 1.9.

score.description: Share of checks that passed in the newest report that had a count, 0 to 100.

nextCursor.description: Pass the previous page's nextCursor to get the next page.

fingerprint.description: The same on every report: the control and the resource.

control.description: The benchmark's own number, such as 5.2.1.

nextCursor.description: Pass the previous page's nextCursor to get the next page.

checks.description: From the report's `properties.summary`, or its results of kind `pass`; null when it gives neither.

score.description: checks.passed as a share of checks.total, 0 to 100.

new.description: Failed controls the engine did not report before and nobody has decided about.

resolved.description: Failed controls this engine reported before and does not now.

suppressed.description: New failed controls someone had decided about.

ignored.description: Failed results that name no resource.

blocking.description: New failed controls at or above failOn. Always 0 for the first report of an engine, which adopts what is there.

findings.description: The new failed controls, most severe first, up to 100.

nextCursor.description: Pass the previous page's nextCursor to get the next page.

points.description: Oldest first. Reports without a check count are left out.

HostsCoverage.description: The hosts file (ADR 0052), shared with the other products that work with servers, and the servers in it Posture has no posture scan for. It is read again within a minute of a change; a file that cannot be applied leaves its last good version.

appliedAt.description: When it was last read and applied; null if it never was.

error.description: Why the file on disk is not applied.

missing.description: Servers Posture knows by neither their name nor their address (host targets).
